why: Refuses to re-select once a target has been lost, which leaves an AI permanently blind to an opponent that RESPAWNS. `stepRespawns` revives a tank in place -- same id, `alive` back to true -- so nothing about the world tells the AI a new opponent has appeared; it has to re-read `isTargetable` every tick, and this mutation is what 'remembering the loss' looks like as a plausible optimisation. Every other case in the file still passes: death dropping the commitment is unaffected, and no other fixture brings a dead tank back. -- FIND-STRING REPOINTED (issue #891): The selector moved behind `CommitmentPolicy` when #891 extracted the shared policy; the mutation is unchanged in meaning -- refuse to reacquire after a loss.
killedBy: committed opponent selection reacquires a target that dies and RESPAWNS, rather than staying blind to it
